chunks: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:

God has prescribed jihad upon men and women. The jihad of the man is the giving of his wealth and his self until he is killed in the way of God; and the jihad of the woman is that she endures patiently what she sees of harm from her husband and his jealousy.
And in another narration: the jihad of the woman is excellence in wifely devotion.

key_terms.التبعّل: Wifely devotion — being a good wife, fulfilling marital duties with excellence
key_terms.الجهاد: Jihad — striving in God's way; here used in its broadest sense encompassing both armed struggle and patient moral effort
key_terms.بذل: Giving, sacrificing, expending — connoting wholehearted self-offering
key_terms.سبيل الله: The way of God — the path of divine guidance and service

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the jihad of men and women in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) defines jihad as a duty ordained by God for both men and women, but with different forms. For men, it is the sacrifice of wealth and life in God's way; for women, it is patient endurance of marital difficulties. This teaching reflects how classical Islamic jurisprudence understood gendered roles in religious obligation, framing domestic virtue as a form of spiritual striving equivalent in merit to armed struggle.
